Feature: Login Functionality for Doctors, Chemists, and Labs

  Scenario Outline: Valid login for Doctors, Chemists, and Labs
    Given the <user_type> has been set up with a default password by Admin
    When the <user_type> attempts to log in with the default password
    Then the system should allow the <user_type> to log in successfully

    Examples:
      | user_type |
      | Doctor    |
      | Chemist   |
      | Lab       |

  Scenario Outline: Invalid login for Doctors, Chemists, and Labs with incorrect password
    Given the <user_type> has been set up with a default password by Admin
    When the <user_type> attempts to log in with an incorrect password
    Then the system should display an error message "Invalid password"

    Examples:
      | user_type |
      | Doctor    |
      | Chemist   |
      | Lab       |

  Scenario Outline: Invalid login for Doctors, Chemists, and Labs with empty password
    Given the <user_type> has been set up with a default password by Admin
    When the <user_type> attempts to log in with an empty password
    Then the system should display an error message "Password cannot be empty"

    Examples:
      | user_type |
      | Doctor    |
      | Chemist   |
      | Lab       |
